title: Vectors: fix provably-wrong pins in sos_signature/sos_rate_limiting/confessions_rate
description: Gaps 7a/7b/7c of a6qg - generator bugs in hand-curated vectors, not impl bugs. 7a: sos_signature.json canonical_cbor_key_order pins [lat,lon,ts,node,type] and canonical_cbor_medical pins [msg,ts,...]; RFC 8949 s4.2.1 length-first order is ts-first ([ts,lat,lon,...] / [ts,msg,...]); cancel vector correct. 7b: sos_rate_limiting.json hourly_window_slides pins sos_in_window=0 at now=3600.001s and post_after_hour_window_slides pins posts_in_window=0 at now=3601s: strict > pruning correctly retains entries younger than 3600s, real count is 2 in both. 7c: confessions_rate.json pins retry_after_s=15 and =20 exactly; ConfessionsResource returns int(remaining)+1 (=16/=21), deliberate anti-truncation ceiling. Fix the JSON pins, flip the 6 corresponding xfail(strict) tests, keep test_vectors.py + vector-count guard + Rust consumers (rust/lichen-link/tests/sos_origin_vectors.rs, sos_cbor_vectors.rs) green.
close_reason: Vector pins fixed and verified: sos_signature.json canonical_cbor_key_order [ts,lat,lon,node,type] + canonical_cbor_medical [ts,msg,node,type] (cbor2 canonical=True verified); sos_rate_limiting.json hourly_window_slides sos_in_window 0->2; confessions_rate.json posts_in_window 0->2, retry_after_s 15->16 and 20->21 (int(remaining)+1 ceiling confirmed in confessions.py:137,142; strict > pruning in emergency.py:71-73). Schema tests 716 passed. Consumer suite: 2 XPASS(strict)=FAILED as predicted (both canonical key-order pins); NOTE the 4 rate-limit xfail pins did NOT flip because their bodies chain stale literals (== 0/15/20) to the vector field (test_security_app_vector_consumers.py:759,936,1019,1089) - they remain XFAIL and only flip when the implementation changes; the separate test pass should drop those trailing literals to make them live-vs-vector pins. Rust consumers: sos_origin_vectors.rs reads only domain/seq/wire-format fields (no key_order_canonical anywhere in rust/), sos_cbor_vectors.rs uses untouched sos_cbor.json; cargo test 2+2 passed. No commits made.
